caption: The drawing depicts a metal cooking pot with a lid, shown in a slightly angled side view. The pot is dark brown or black in color and has a smooth, rounded body. It stands on three short, tapered legs, elevating it above the surface. The lid is domed and also dark, with a triangular handle at the top formed by two curved elements meeting at a point. Extending from one side of the pot is a single, long, straight handle that narrows towards the end, matching the color and texture of the pot. The background of the drawing is light beige, and the main object is enclosed within a thin, reddish-brown rectangular border. In the upper right corner, there is a small inset diagram showing a simple line drawing of the same pot, annotated with dimensions. There is a numeric notation "25" in the lower right corner.
title: Iron Pot with Cover
